selection_contract.start: Use templates/README.md to shortlist by tone, density and supported layouts; use this JSON for exact filtering.
selection_contract.depth: Read shortlisted previews when a visual choice is useful; read the selected full design recipe before building.
selection_contract.family: Family records provenance, not a safe/bold/wildcard selection quota.
selection_contract.maturity: Recipe means substantial guidance; preset means visual seed; starter means preliminary house scaffolding; developed means specific house guidance/assets. None is rendered acceptance.
selection_contract.assets: Localize external fonts used. System and bundled fonts still require checks with actual audience text.
selection_contract.visible_slide_rule: Keep template names, slugs, paths and option labels outside audience slide content.
